name: What materials are commonly used for sliding door sills?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for sliding door sills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for sliding door sills include wood (often pressure-treated to resist rot), aluminum, and vinyl (PVC). Each material offers different benefits: wood provides a traditional look but requires maintenance; aluminum is durable and low-maintenance; and vinyl offers good insulation and weather resistance. The best material for your repair often depends on the existing door frame, aesthetic preferences, and environmental exposure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood, aluminum, and vinyl are common sill materials, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and insulation properties.
